$comment: LitNode gauntlet config for a Deckwright title (node/gauntlet.js). Copy it, set cwd to your game checkout (pnpm install at its root) and TCG_GAME to your config, then in the node's environment: GAUNTLETS=<rulesetId>=<absolute path to your copy>, GAUNTLET_GATEWAY_PORT=8478, RULESETS=<path to rulesets/<rulesetId>.js>. The node spawns one server per placed match; it seats players by ticket, orders the log, collects both signatures and posts to /ledger.
